implementation_notes: This is Version 2 of EDPS guidance issued under Regulation (EU) 2018/1725 (EUDPR), applicable specifically to EU institutions, bodies, offices and agencies (EUIs). The document is explicitly not issued under the AI Act market surveillance authority role. Enforcement is primarily through GDPR-style accountability mechanisms and EDPS supervisory authority rather than direct penalties. The guidance is non-prescriptive on technical measures but establishes baseline data protection compliance expectations for all stages of the generative AI lifecycle. Several referenced documents (e.g., EDPS Guidance for Risk Management for AI systems) are noted as forthcoming.
